environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on ECS Fargate with task role 'ws-service-task-role'. The role's DynamoDB policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition key with variable substitution referencing a request context tag propagated from the authenticated session principal. Specifically, the IAM policy includes a Condition block: ForAllValues:StringEquals on dynamodb:LeadingKeys mapped to ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_partition_key}. The ECS task definition sets the propagation via credential vending through an STS AssumeRole chain where the session tags are injected by the authentication layer (Cognito identity pool with attribute mapping from sub claim to tenant_partition_key). Additionally, the VPC endpoint policy for DynamoDB restricts the dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition independently. The ALB has a listener rule that inspects the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header and drops connections not presenting a rotating nonce issued during page load via a separate /csrf-token endpoint with SameSite=Strict cookie binding.

config.alb_config: Listener rule requires Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header matching rotating nonce from /csrf-token (SameSite=Strict cookie-bound)
config.auth_chain: Cognito -> STS AssumeRole with session tag tenant_partition_key = authenticated user's sub claim
config.network: Private subnet, VPC endpoint for DynamoDB with restrictive policy
